title: National Museum of Ethiopia

terrainReference.basis: Original ground immediately at the lower end of the mapped entrance steps. Individual tread levels are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap way 200657467 supplies the permanent museum footprint. Mapped steps 1535018949 join its east wall to the path from the site gate. The named site way 44049497 covers the larger museum compound.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 200657467 identifies the named permanent exhibition building. Steps way 1535018949 joins the east entrance to the museum grounds.

note: The September 2016 cleared photograph fixes the raised glazed level, board-formed concrete fins, broad east stair, canopy and sloping foundation bays. The facade artwork is outside the architectural reconstruction. Exact roof and secondary elevations remain approximate.
